# Release tooling

Turns merged pull requests and conventional commits into release notes and changelog entries.

Export GITHUB_TOKEN before starting Claude Code.

## What it adds

- Skills: `release-notes`, `changelog-keeper`
- Commands: `release-notes`

## Install

```text
/plugin install devdigest-release@dev-digest-ai-marketplace
```

## What it runs

### GITHUB_TOKEN

A fine-grained token with read access to pull requests and contents is enough.
